text.en: Drain boiled potatoes and leave them out of cold water.
text.de: Gekochte Kartoffeln abgießen und nicht in kaltem Wasser abschrecken.

why.en: Unlike most other vegetables, potatoes turn soggy when refreshed in cold water.
why.de: Anders als die meisten anderen Gemüse werden Kartoffeln im kalten Wasser matschig.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables, and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 4 Potatoes, section 4.2 Purchasing, Storing and Preparing Potatoes
sources.sentence: Unlike other vegetables, potatoes should not be refreshed in cold water; it makes them soggy.
